title: Correct elastic force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 5000√3 N or its numerical equivalent.

title: Correct relative sliding distance
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 1.8 m.

title: Force equilibrium for static case
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must apply force equilibrium to the top pipe, correctly resolving the normal force from the lower pipes.

title: Friction force during braking
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly calculate the kinetic friction force on the top pipe as the net force causing its deceleration.

title: Relative acceleration analysis
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must compare the decelerations of the truck and the top pipe to find their relative motion.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly apply kinematics equations (v² = u² + 2as) for both the truck and the sliding pipe.

title: Unit conversion
description: Optional: The solution should correctly convert the initial speed from km/h to m/s.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the wrong sign for deceleration in kinematics equations or misinterprets the direction of relative motion.

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall: Penalize if, in part (1), the student incorrectly resolves the contact forces (e.g., using the wrong angle or omitting the 1/2 factor from symmetry).
